title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Wing Junction Harnesses
abstract: Wiring diagram for the wing junction harnesses at the centre fuselage, showing the disconnect brackets, the bonding arrangement and the harnesses that continue into the landing gear bay.

sections.purpose: Wiring diagram of the wing junction harnesses at the centre fuselage, including the disconnect brackets and the continuation into the landing gear bay.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking forward at the wing junction with the belly fairing panels removed. The disconnect brackets on both sides are the boundary between the fuselage and the wing harness sets and are the point at which a wing removal splits the wiring. The bonding leads shown at the brackets are the ones measured during the bay inspection and their specified contact areas are called out on the sheet, because a reading taken to painted structure is meaningless.
sections.routing_note: Harnesses run outboard from the centre fuselage through the disconnect brackets and then along the front spar. The landing gear bay continuation drops at the station shown and carries a drip loop below the bay ceiling penetration. The support interval tightens through the bay because the harness is exposed to the gear airflow.
